label: Electronic public procurement system outdated and in need of redesign
definition: The electronic public procurement system is outdated or functionally inadequate: it does not support all procedures, tools or stages of the procurement cycle set out in law, hampers centralised procurement, and has to be re-engineered or replaced by a new system.
why_not_existing: RI-TEC-006 is defined as a system that works but whose modules are incomplete or little used. Moldova's EU texts (2021 to 2025) say the system is outdated, inadequate and must be overhauled or replaced, a different stage of development. Widening RI-TEC-006 instead would change an issue cited by the closed run (S4).

label: Domestic preconditions for the European Health Insurance Card not in place
definition: The country has no national health insurance card or integrated health information system, so it cannot yet issue or accept the European Health Insurance Card at accession.
why_not_existing: RI-FMW-011 concerns EHIC access being limited to countries with bilateral arrangements; RI-FMW-010 concerns electronic exchange (EESSI) and electronic health insurance data. Neither covers the absence of a domestic card and health information system as a precondition. A Chapter 2 issue, so no theme materiality test applies; the analyst may consider a TECH-INTEROP or TECH-DATA tag, since the cause is a missing information system.

label: Admission rules for third-country workers not aligned with EU legal migration directives
definition: The country has only general rules on admitting foreign workers and no legislation transposing the EU legal migration directives, such as the single application procedure and single permit for work and residence or the admission of researchers.
why_not_existing: RI-FMW-014 (added at G5 from international organisation evidence) concerns barriers to labour market access and protection of rights after admission, not legal alignment of admission rules with EU directives. Scope note: the text is printed under Chapter 24; the run record places admission of foreign workers inside the Chapter 2 boundary, which pass 2 is asked to confirm. The analyst may prefer to treat these items under RI-FMW-014.

label: Administrative data and registers for official statistics incomplete
definition: The statistical office lacks a statistical population register or adequate legal access to administrative data on individuals, limiting the production of official statistics in line with EU standards.
why_not_existing: RI-TEC-015 concerns the quality and digitalisation of base registers used across government; a statistical register and the statistical office's legal access to data are a different problem. All three items are flagged theme_doubtful, so the issue may fail the theme test; if the analyst rules the theme does not apply, the items are out of scope rather than a new issue.

label: Fragmented and non-interoperable information systems within a sector
definition: A ministry and its subordinate bodies run many separate information systems that do not exchange data, causing data management problems, weakening evidence-based policy and excluding eligible users.
why_not_existing: RI-TEC-028 concerns use of the national interoperability platform for ex officio data sharing between institutions; RI-TEC-004 concerns shared government-wide building blocks. Fragmentation of one sector's own systems is neither. Both items are theme_doubtful and R22 places back-office sector systems out, so this candidate may fail the scope test; listed so the analyst can decide.
